R-03 list is checked before a Départ is signed}
number : text [0..1] {MCR-YYYY-NNNN, reserved at the preview (F-18)}
status : draft | awaiting_signature | active | closed | void {SQL functions only}

All tables include created_at and created_by (diagram 05).
Client fields are copied into renter_* and additional_* columns.
PricingLines is a field group: pricing_* on revisions,
final_pricing_* on inspections. Amounts are numeric(10,2);
only balance may be negative. All free text is bounded in SQL.
